Updated Base + Football Seat

Supported, Not Overhanging.

DIGITAL FIT CHECKS
Four Broad Base Faces

Rounded corners preserve the softer profile. Recessed front and rear seats keep the title and champion plates inside the base footprint, with protected edges.

Round Stem, Local Football Mount

The full circular stem supports the cup all the way around. A small football-shaped pad blends into its front; only that mounting face is flat. The football retains approximately 360 mm² of supported digital contact area.

The cup, five family shields and football detail are preserved. Glue strength, clearances and physical fit still need a test print.

Review Status And Sources

The main option remains Slate & Copper. The five alternatives are live comparisons only; they don't change the saved design choice. All use the four-sided base, complete circular pedestal and localized football mounting pad, with the same cup, five family shields and football relief. The original San Francisco trophy files haven't been modified.

Slate, copper and ivory are design colors, not verified matches to the Galaxy Nebulae and green filament you own. Physical shades and sheen need sample comparison. No filament purchases have been made. This page is a visual review, not a print-ready release.

This model is for visual review. No Fusion validation, production-solid qualification, slicing or physical print/fit testing has been completed for this cup. It's a display trophy, not drinkware.
